question: How many members of the Student_Club have majored Environmental Engineering?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "majors_catalog" AS SELECT "major_id" AS "major_id", "major_name" AS "major_name" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "member_attributes" AS SELECT "member_id" AS "member_id", "shuxing" AS "attribute_key", "zhi" AS "attribute_value" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH direct_name AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id
  FROM member_attributes
  WHERE lower(attribute_key) IN ('major','major_name','major name')
    AND lower(trim(attribute_value)) = 'environmental engineering'
),
via_link AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ma.member_id
  FROM member_attributes ma
  JOIN majors_catalog mc
    ON ma.attribute_value = mc.major_id
  WHERE lower(ma.attribute_key) IN ('major_id','majorid','link_to_major','link to major','major link')
    AND lower(trim(mc.major_name)) = 'environmental engineering'
),
all_matches AS (
  SELECT member_id FROM direct_name
  UNION
  SELECT member_id FROM via_link
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS environmental_engineering_majors
FROM all_matches;
